exposure.needed: which dashboards, alerts or other metric consumers query the old embedded cache metric names (querier_cache_added_new_total, querier_cache_evicted_total, querier_cache_entries, querier_cache_memory_bytes)

consequence.statement: Loki keeps running but exports the embedded cache metrics under the new loki_embeddedcache_* names, so any dashboard, alert or other consumer querying the old querier_cache_* names no longer matches those metrics.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards, alert rules and other metric consumers to the new loki_embeddedcache_* metric names.

assertion.statement: In Loki 3.0.0 the embedded cache metrics are renamed: querier_cache_added_new_total, querier_cache_evicted_total, querier_cache_entries and querier_cache_memory_bytes become loki_embeddedcache_added_new_total, loki_embeddedcache_evicted_total, loki_embeddedcache_entries and loki_embeddedcache_memory_bytes respectively.
